lines: [excited] Okay, there's a secret room hidden behind Mount Rushmore's faces!
Okay, there's a SECRET ROOM hidden behind Mount Rushmore's FACES!
[laughs] A secret room? What's in there, the spare noses?
A SECRET ROOM? What's in there, the SPARE NOSES?
[laughs] No spare noses! But the room is real... and something is inside.
No spare noses! But the room is REAL... and something is INSIDE.
Before the carving, the Lakota knew this mountain as the Six Grandfathers.
Before the carving, the LAKOTA knew this mountain as the SIX GRANDFATHERS.
So how do you carve a face sixty feet tall? [mischievously] Dynamite!
So how do you carve a face SIXTY FEET tall? DYNAMITE!
[surprised] You blasted ninety percent of a face... with dynamite... to within inches?!
You blasted NINETY PERCENT of a face... with DYNAMITE... to within INCHES?!
[laughs] Yep! Then they drilled holes like a honeycomb and chipped the rest off. Very gently.
Yep! Then they drilled holes like a HONEYCOMB and chipped the rest OFF. Very GENTLY.
Crews dangled off the cliff on cables, and in fourteen years, not one worker died.
Crews DANGLED off the cliff on CABLES, and in FOURTEEN YEARS, not one worker died.
Fun fact: Jefferson started on Washington's other side. The rock was too cracked... so they blasted him off!
Fun fact: JEFFERSON started on Washington's OTHER side. The rock was too CRACKED... so they BLASTED him off!
[laughs] Dynamited out of the group photo. That's cold.
DYNAMITED out of the GROUP PHOTO. That's COLD.
Now, the secret room! They dug a seventy-foot tunnel for a Hall of Records... and then work just... stopped.
Now, the SECRET ROOM! They dug a SEVENTY-FOOT tunnel for a HALL OF RECORDS... and then work just... STOPPED.
[excited] Until 1998! They sealed a titanium vault in there, under a twelve-hundred-pound granite lid!
Until 1998! They sealed a TITANIUM VAULT in there, under a 1,200-POUND granite lid!
Porcelain panels... with the story of the carving and the country!
PORCELAIN PANELS... with the story of the CARVING and the COUNTRY!
[laughs] Basically! And granite wears away an inch every ten thousand years... so that homework isn't going anywhere.
Basically! And granite wears away AN INCH every TEN THOUSAND YEARS... so that HOMEWORK isn't going anywhere.
